newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Construction firm Impact SA joins Romanian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Construction firm Impact SA joins Romanian bourse.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Wednesday private construction company Impact SA would start trading on November 7, bringing to 14 the total number of stocks.
The statement also said another seven companies -- including a pharmaceutical firm, a packaging company, an oil exploration concern and a plumbing manufacturer -- had applied for listing.
It did not say when the seven were expected to get a quotation or when their shares would start trading.
Impact, based in Bucharest, has 855.9 million lei in share capital -- or 142,646 shares with a face value of 6,000 lei each.
It made 1995 net profits of 249.8 million lei, up from 247.3 million the previous year, and has forecast a 1996 net profit of 732.3 million lei on turnover doubled to 4.6 billion lei.

The Bursa de Valori Bucuresti, which opened last November, currently trades 13 stocks of which only one -- syringe maker Sanevit SA -- is privately held. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
